data.body:
TRIAGE NOTE — expect self-referential re-firings until this lands.

The trigger is a review whose text names the marker vocabulary, and the fix for this bug is itself
a change to infra/scripts/observability.sh — so every LLM-Review of MY OWN changes here (this one,
and the just-merged cold-start fix e2a6-9ee4-8d5c-4290 / Gerrit 1686) writes the tokens VOTER_ERROR
and MERGE_CHANGE_ERROR into the review-bot journal as prose and can re-fire
rebar-gerrit-voter-errors and rebar-review-bot-merge-change-errors.

Any firing of those two alarms between now and this change merging should be checked against the
review-bot journal for a line-start '<TOKEN> {json}' record before being treated as real: if the
only match is inside LLM review prose, it is this bug, not a voter or merge-path failure. The
review-bot kept voting normally throughout the 23:07Z firing (voter_voted at 23:05:08Z, 23:13:04Z,
23:19:38Z), which is the same corroboration to look for.
